name: Default
shortDescription: Open source chat UI for Ollama with document and image uploads, bundled with a private CPU-only Ollama server for local models.

alerts.message: No model is installed. Run ollama pull mistral (the UI default) or a smaller model in the chatbot-ollama-ollama container, then pick it in the model menu. Ollama runs on CPU only: mistral needs about 5 GB of free RAM and smaller models respond faster.
Chatbot Ollama has no login: anyone who knows the URL can chat with your models and use the server CPU.
